These are priors, not measured results. I have no NAS-Bench-201 data loaded here, so I reasoned from structure: removing a conv hurts more than removing a skip or pool, self-upgrades have smaller marginal gains than upgrades from none, and "consistent across three datasets with a meaningful margin" is a demanding bar, so most interaction claims get low values.
